name: vp-beads
description: Sprint workflow automation for projects using the diarie flat-YAML tracker and Basic Memory. Ships /retrospective and nothing else — the session hooks moved to the plugins that own them. Five sibling plugins live in this monorepo alongside it: ledger (upstream + sibling relationship tracking), swarm-wave (multi-agent orchestration), diarie-adopt (tracker migration), vp-dream (file-memory consolidation) and diarie (the everyday tracker hooks).
